messages.subject: Cedarbridge - funding confirmation for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

We're targeting completion of the Cedarbridge acquisition on 12 December. Can you confirm the senior facility drawdown conditions and the date by which you need the CP checklist satisfied? Our solicitors (James Osei at Whitfield Carter, copied) will liaise with you directly on the security and the certificate of title.

Rebecca Stone
Finance Director, Thornbury Properties

messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

Drawdown is available subject to the usual CPs: executed facility and security documents, certificate of title in our agreed form, valuation (received), and evidence of the buyer's equity. Please have the certificate of title to us at least three business days before completion. Happy to take James's call on the security package.

Priya Sharma
Pennine Business Bank plc
